name: Pale-Threshold
description: Pale-Threshold exists at the frozen edge of habitability, a small world locked in eternal stillness with one face forever turned toward its distant sun. The lit hemisphere receives just enough warmth to keep methane marginally liquid in sheltered craters, while the dark side plunges to temperatures that approach absolute zero. Impact scars cover every surface, the accumulated damage of billions of years unmarred by weather or erosion.

The near-zero gravity makes movement dreamlike, each step launching visitors into long, floating arcs that take conscious effort to control. Sound exists only through contact, vibrations traveling through suit boots and gloves while the world above remains perfectly silent. The frozen lakes shimmer with patterns created by slow convection, hypnotic swirls that seem to move differently each time they're observed.

The colony ship Hopeful Venture came to rest here two centuries ago, its navigation systems corrupted by a solar flare that sent it tumbling off course during the final approach to its destination. The crew survived the crash but not the aftermath—their supplies exhausted within months, their distress calls unanswered. The Venture's hull still stands, preserved perfectly by the cold, a monument to dreams that fell short of their destination.

The navigation beacon established by the recovery mission serves as warning and waypoint, its signal reminding passing ships of the dangers lurking in routine voyages. The Venture itself has become a pilgrimage site for some, a place to contemplate the thin margins between success and tragedy. The colonists' personal effects remain undisturbed within, their final messages recorded and archived but rarely accessed. Some stories are too heavy to carry, even in the weightlessness of Pale-Threshold's feeble gravity.
